label: Beginningless sustained esse without origination or modal necessity, against a no-giver profile
summary: Follow-up to attempt c94eed5b. Unregistered kernel theorem TruthCore.Results.Causality.SustainingCausation.beginninglessSustainingControls of type SustainingCausation.Control.BeginninglessCertificate (PR #1886). One two-world History Bool Bool Int: giver true and effect false present at every integer moment of world true, both absent in world false; CoherentAtNow holds. Certified: both bearers ContingentAt (effect and giver); the effect is everlasting and not NecessaryAt; a stationarity rule (StationaryExistence) holds in both worlds, so it does not entail the effect's presence; under the giving profile the giver SustainsBeing the effect, gives at every moment and satisfies contact, while OriginatesBeing fails because every candidate first moment has an earlier one; the giver is itself given being by nothing; under the no-giver profile nothing gives the effect being at now, and nothing sustains or originates it. Findings: sustaining is satisfiable with no originating moment and does not make the effect de re necessary; a stationary history is compatible with a giver or with no giver, and neither profile selects the populated world. The no-giver profile is incompatible with 40a97664 for a received-esse bearer (typed in TimeSymmetricGiving Control part (1)); no received-esse predicate is encoded here. Structural surrogate: empty alternative world, empty Causes, GivesAt stipulated with no link to CausesIn or esse; the no-giver profile is a surrogate for the inertialist profile, whose explanatory content TimeSymmetricGiving part (1) types. The effect-side reading of the GivesAt time index is the module's stipulation, not a result: contact makes the giver IsAt every moment, which on the inclusive IsAt reading of c94eed5b equally fits an everlasting temporal giver. Novelty: TimeSymmetricGiving Control parts (1) eternal inertia and (5) eternal sustaining (one world) and TemporalHistoryControls.JointControls (everlasting contingent target) already separate each feature; the delta is both features in one two-world model plus an explicit not-OriginatesBeing. No root-premise change.
blocker: Not blocked; branch reassessment. Next tests: same-source productive giving across timeless and temporal readings of the giver; a stronger inertia-law explanation at whole-history scope (#1801); C1/C2 supplier and termination principles (#1616); the contingent giver's own received-esse status under C2 (#1884, 6508c239).
